content: प्रयोक्तृ {%a.%} .²1 One who uses or employs (as a means, word <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 One who performs or directs, an executor. .²3 One who prompts or instigates, an instigator. .²4 An author, an agent; स च कुलपतिराद्यश्छन्दसां यः प्रयोक्ता <ls>U. 3. 48</ls>. .²5 One who acts or represents (a drama). .²6 One who lends money at interest, a money-lender. .²7 One who shoots (an arrow). .²8 The agent of an action. .²9 A reciter. .²10 A procurer.
